lead_raw_text:
The structure of Nb4Mg12Si4 (reduced formula NbMg3Si) crystallizes in the orthorhombic space group Imma (No. 216), with 20 atoms in the unit cell distributed over four independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis identifies close-packed-like local arrangements for all three elements: each Mg center has 12 geometric neighbors, while each Nb and Si center has 12 neighbors, with neighbor distances spanning roughly 2.82–3.21 Å. This analysis also finds that the periodic neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component containing all 20 sites. Validated polyhedron contacts show Mg–Mg 12-vertex polyhedra sharing corners, edges, and faces, while Mg–Nb and Mg–Si pairs share corners and edges.
